Promotion Rules
Important Notes
## 1. Participation Details
Users are deemed to have read and agreed to the Bitget Simple Earn Product Agreement.
Promotion rewards apply to main accounts only and are valid only during the promotion period. Institutional users are not currently eligible.
To view the Simple Earn APR boost promotion in the app, update the Bitget app to version V2.91.0 or later.
## 2. Net deposit calculation
Net deposit amount = deposit amount − withdrawal amount. Internal transfers are not counted.
The USDT activity tracks net deposits in USDT, USDC and USDGO, all converted to USDT for calculation. The BTC, ETH and XAUT activities track net deposits of the respective coins only.
## 3. Eligibility updates and effective time
The system checks each user's net deposits and subscriptions daily and automatically updates promotion eligibility between 12:00 AM and 8:00 AM (UTC+8) the following day. Once eligibility is updated, the corresponding Simple Earn product starts earning the boost; users who do not meet the conditions receive the base APR only.
Both net deposit and interest accrual follow T+1 logic. For example, a subscription or net deposit completed between 11:00 PM and 11:59:59 PM (UTC+8) on day D is counted as of 12:00 AM on day D+1, and promotion eligibility is updated on day D+2.
## 4. Boost calculation and limits
Promotion rewards apply only to principal within each promotion's boost cap. Any amount above the cap does not earn the promotion boost.
Promotion rewards are calculated daily on the user's hourly average holdings from the previous day.
Redeeming principal during the promotion period may void your eligibility or affect the bonus APR you are currently earning.
Total promotion rewards are capped and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Individual rewards are also capped; once your individual cap is reached, no further promotion rewards will be granted.
## 5. Rule changes and violations
Users must complete identity verification and meet the product and promotion eligibility requirements that apply in their country or region.
Data, limits, APRs and reward estimates displayed on the promotion page are for reference only. The final basis is Bitget's backend settlement records and the relevant promotion announcements. If the promotion cannot proceed normally due to system issues, market conditions, liquidity, regulatory requirements, force majeure or other reasonable causes, Bitget reserves the right to adjust the promotion rules, limits, APR, eligibility and promotion period.
All participants must strictly comply with Bitget's terms and conditions. If fraud, the use of multiple accounts to claim rewards, or participation through electronic, bot, duplicate or automated means is detected, Bitget reserves the right to disqualify the participant and revoke their rewards, and promotion rewards on the relevant accounts will be voided.
This promotion is open only to users who meet Bitget's eligibility requirements and whose participation is not restricted by applicable laws, regulatory requirements, regional restrictions, or Bitget's internal policies. Users in restricted regions, users with restricted accounts, and any other users who do not meet Bitget's eligibility requirements may not register for or participate in this promotion, or receive or claim any promotion rewards. Users are responsible for confirming that their participation does not violate the laws and regulations that apply in their location. Bitget may adjust eligibility for this promotion based on legal, regulatory, or risk control requirements. Eligibility, eligible trading volume, and rewards are determined in accordance with these promotion rules and Bitget's final backend settlement records. To the extent permitted by applicable law, Bitget may adjust, suspend, or cancel this promotion due to legal or regulatory requirements, risk control, market changes, system maintenance, force majeure, or other reasonable and necessary causes.
By participating in this promotion, you are deemed to have read, understood, and agreed to the Bitget User Agreement, Privacy Policy, applicable product terms, risk disclosures, and these promotion rules. Bitget reserves the right to revise the promotion terms or cancel the promotion at any time without prior notice, and retains the final right of interpretation of these terms. If you have any questions, please contact our customer service team.
In the event of any discrepancy between a translated version and the English version, the English version shall prevail.

Venue: Gate
Headline: Crazy Wednesday Black Week Special: Register to Draw, Unlock WLFI, Black & Gold Luxuries and High-Yi...

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Black Week begins with an exclusive selection of timeless luxury gifts. Register for this event to receive a mystery box draw chance and unlock exciting rewards, including Rolex Submariner Date two-tone watch, medium Dior Toujours bag, and Van Cleef & Arpels Vintage Alhambra bracelet. Participate in Simple Earn to enjoy up to 100% APR on USDT, and earn up to 16% APR by staking BTC, ETH, or SOL. Multiple rewards are ready — start trading and earning now.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 25, 2026, 6:00 – November 29, 2026, 8:00 (UTC)
## Event 1: Register to Unlock Mystery Boxes
During the event, users who register will receive one mystery box draw chance. Complete the tasks below to earn additional mystery box opportunities. Rewards include WLFI, Rolex Submariner Date two-tone watch, a medium Dior Toujours bag, and a Van Cleef & Arpels Vintage Alhambra bracelet. Limited rewards are available on a first-come, first-served basis. The prize pool is updated daily at 00:00 (UTC). If the prize pool is fully claimed on the final day, the campaign will end automatically.
Reminder: Avoid frequent operations in a short period to prevent triggering risk control, which may affect your eligibility to claim rewards.
- Convert Newbie Task: Complete your first-ever Convert trade (≥ 1 USDT) to earn 1 chance.
- Spot Newbie Task: Complete your first-ever spot trade (≥ 1 USDT) to earn 1 chance.
- Futures Newbie Task: Complete your first-ever futures trade (≥ 500 USDT) to earn 1 chance.
- Deposit Task: Accumulate a net deposit of ≥ 500 USDT and maintain it for at least 24 hours to earn 1 chance.
- Convert Trading Volume Task: Reach 100 USDT in Convert trading volume daily to earn 1 chance.
- Spot Trading Volume Task: Reach the following spot trading volumes to earn mystery box chances (stackable), limited to 1 chance per tier:
Cumulative spot trading volume ≥ 500 USDT — 1 chance
Cumulative spot trading volume ≥ 2,000 USDT — 1 additional chance
Cumulative spot trading volume ≥ 10,000 USDT — 1 additional chance
- Futures Trading Volume Task: Reach the following futures trading volumes to earn mystery box chances (stackable), limited to 1 chance per tier:
Cumulative futures trading volume ≥ 2,000 USDT — 1 chance
Cumulative futures trading volume ≥ 10,000 USDT — 1 additional chance
Cumulative futures trading volume ≥ 50,000 USDT — 1 additional chance
Cumulative futures trading volume ≥ 100,000 USDT — 1 additional chance
Cumulative futures trading volume ≥ 1,000,000 USDT — 1 additional chance
- Referral Task: Invite users to join the event. For each invitee who completes the Newbie Task of futures trade during the event, you will earn 1 chance (up to 10 chances).
- Simple Earn Task : Subscribe ≥ 1,000 USDT to Simple Earn fixed-term products to get 1 chance
- Staking Task: Net staking amount ≥ 1,000 USDT to get 1 chance
- VIP Task: Users completing their first-ever upgrade to VIP 5 or above in the user journey during the event to get 3 chances
## Event 2: Enjoy 6% APR with Simple Earn USDT Products
This session features a limited-time USDT 14-day fixed-term product with up to 6% APR. Users with a net deposit ≥ 1,000 USDT during the event can subscribe. New users can also enjoy an exclusive 3-day product with 100% APR.
Both new and existing users can also participate in Simple Earn for USDE, USDD, KAIO, etc., with an APR of up to 80%.
Coin | Term (Days) | APR | Max Subscription per User
USDT | 14 Days | 6% | 20,000 USDT
USDT | 3 Days | 100% | 500 USDT
USDE | Flexible | 5% | -
USDD | Flexible | 5% | -
KAIO | 7 Days | 80% | -
## Event 3: Stake BTC, ETH and SOL to Enjoy Up to 16% APR
During the event, users who register and participate in staking for BTC, ETH, and SOL can enjoy a bonus APR of up to 8.65%, with total APR reaching up to 16%.
Coin | Net Staking Amount | Estimated APR | Bonus APR | Total APR
BTC | 0-0.01 BTC | 5.17% | 4.50% | 9.67%
BTC | 0.01-50 BTC | 0.67% | 1.00% | 1.67%
BTC | > 50 BTC | 0.37% | 0.30% | 0.67%
ETH | 0-1 ETH | 5.61% | 4.00% | 9.61%
ETH | 1-100 ETH | 3.11% | 0.50% | 3.61%
ETH | 100-1,000 ETH | 2.81% | 0.30% | 3.11%
SOL | 0-1 SOL | 7.35% | 8.65% | 16.00%
SOL | 1-10 SOL | 7% | 5.15% | 11.00%
SOL | 10-50 SOL | 5.25% | 2.75% | 8.00%
## Notes
- Participants must click the [Join Now] button on the event page and complete identity verification to be eligible for rewards.
- Trading Volume = Buy Amount + Sell Amount. During the USD1 futures trading pair fee discount promotion, futures trading volume for the relevant promotional pairs will be calculated at 50%. Net Deposit = Total Deposits – Total Withdrawals During the Event. Only on-chain deposits, P2P, and fiat deposits are counted. Internal transfers are not included. During the event, trading volume generated by trading bots will be excluded from the event's trading volume calculations and will not count toward meeting the requirements of related tasks.
- During the event, API trading volume will count toward the event's trading volume calculations, while trading volume generated by trading bots will be excluded. Trading volume generated by copy trading sub-accounts will be aggregated into their respective parent accounts: volume from copy trading sub-accounts under a main account will be attributed to the main account, while volume from those under a regular sub-account will only be attributed to that regular sub-account and will not be aggregated into the main account.
- Simple Earn data was updated on November 25, 2026. The actual APR is subject to the subscription page.
- Staking data was updated on November 25 2026. The actual APR is subject to the subscription page.
- Net Staking Amount = Total Staked Amount – Total Redemption Amount (both during the event).
- Token rewards for Event 1 will be distributed in WLFI tokens. Users who draw a lucky bag will share a total reward pool of 10,000 USDT, distributed in WLFI tokens, based on the proportion of lucky bags they receive. Physical rewards will be [airdropped] to users via the Gate Shop. Users must claim rewards within the validity period; unclaimed rewards will be deemed forfeited. Once an order is successfully placed in the Gate Shop, the product details and shipping information cannot be modified. Please ensure all information is accurate and complete before submitting your order. (Physical rewards cannot be returned or exchanged once shipped.) If a user provides incorrect or incomplete information, refuses delivery, returns the item, or cannot be contacted, the reward will be considered forfeited. Physical rewards will be delivered within 60 days after the submission of shipping details. Please monitor your logistics updates. If delivery cannot be completed due to force majeure or shipping issues, an equivalent amount in USDT will be issued instead. The event will automatically end once all rewards have been distributed. All rewards will be distributed to users' accounts within 14 working days after the event ends.
- Quotas for Event 2 are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. For detailed rules on subscription, redemption, and interest distribution, please refer to the product subscription page.
- The bonus APR for Event 3 will be distributed in GT (equivalent value) to users' accounts within 7 working days after the event ends.
- Gate will review account activity, transactions, and fund transfers during the event. Violations include participating repeatedly through multiple accounts, identity impersonation or submission of false verification information, wash trading or matched trading, circular transfers of on-chain funds, coordinated reward abuse, repeated fund transfers, and any other activities that compromise the fairness of the event. Gate reserves the right to disqualify users found to have engaged in such violations from receiving rewards.
- Market makers, enterprises, institutions are not eligible for this event.
- In case of any discrepancies between the translated version and the English version, the English version shall prevail.
- Gate reserves the right of final interpretation for this event.
- Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions cannot use all or part of the services (including participation in this event, game, or competition). For details on restricted regions, please read the User Agreement .
